rule: The leaderboard ranks prospective escrow entries only. No backtest number may appear here: the renderer reads this file and nothing else.

entries.name: Singles shadow baseline (ratings only)
entries.gates: G1 n>=200; G2 cluster-bootstrap Brier skill > 0 vs devigged market; G3 BH q=0.10; G4 no refit on holdout; G5 side balance 35-65%; G6 price basis >= 50% real prices
entries.confirm_if: Skill score lower bound > 0 on >= 200 graded singles AND mean CLV > 0 with its CI above 0
entries.refute_if: Brier skill lower bound <= 0 on 200 graded singles OR side share outside 35-65% for 4 consecutive weeks
entries.demotion_trigger: 3 consecutive weeks with the skill lower bound at or below 0, or any refit on graded data

entries.name: Personnel-surprise singles
entries.gates: Same six gates plus G7 ablation delta must beat PR-01 on the same games with a CI excluding zero
entries.confirm_if: Delta Brier vs PR-01 has a lower bound above 0 on >= 200 games
entries.refute_if: Delta lower bound <= 0 after 200 games or the beta CI from history crosses 0
entries.demotion_trigger: 3 consecutive weeks with the skill lower bound at or below 0, or any refit on graded data

entries.name: Total T1 scoring-rate singles
entries.confirm_if: Skill > 0 vs market and CLV CI above 0
entries.demotion_trigger: 3 consecutive weeks with the skill lower bound at or below 0, or any refit on graded data

entries.name: Total T2 context singles
entries.gates: Same six gates plus G8 head-to-head vs PR-03 with a CI excluding zero on the paired MAE
entries.confirm_if: Paired MAE difference favours T2 with CI above 0
entries.refute_if: Paired difference CI contains 0 after 200 games
entries.demotion_trigger: 3 consecutive weeks with the skill lower bound at or below 0, or any refit on graded data

entries.name: Random-picks control
entries.confirm_if: Control should land near zero skill
entries.refute_if: Control shows positive skill (which would indicate a scoring bug)
entries.demotion_trigger: 3 consecutive weeks with the skill lower bound at or below 0, or any refit on graded data

entries.name: Favourites-only control
entries.confirm_if: Control should land near zero skill
entries.refute_if: Control shows positive skill (which would indicate a scoring or sign bug)
entries.demotion_trigger: 3 consecutive weeks with the skill lower bound at or below 0, or any refit on graded data

entries.name: Game parlay (side plus total same game)
entries.gates: Joint-evidence gate G9: a directly validated joint probability for the two legs plus the operator void and push rules
entries.confirm_if: Both hold for >= 100 games with the joint term measured
entries.refute_if: Joints differ from the independence assumption by less than the payoff gap (parlay is unpriceable)
entries.demotion_trigger: 3 consecutive weeks with the skill lower bound at or below 0, or any refit on graded data

entries.name: Player prop combo
entries.gates: G10 requires verified prop prices; a prop outcome feed and operator void rules; none exist in this repository
entries.refute_if: Any single missing input keeps it closed
entries.demotion_trigger: 3 consecutive weeks with the skill lower bound at or below 0, or any refit on graded data

reward_rule: No reward settles on a division with fewer than 200 graded singles; today every division has 0.
